evidence.description: REQ-001..018 close the nine-dependency same-run behavior, strict temporal interval, exact polling and side-effect budgets, closed success/failure channels, historical immutability, and legal strict Phase 1c gating without claiming Phase 2 or L3 completion.

The architecture fixes receipt, exact timestamp, impossible-date, freshness, correlation, polling, timeout/deadline, schema, same-run, exact-lower-bound, stale/future/malformed/before-run/mixed-run/fresh-only cases as binary obligations.

Exact reply/webhook/email attempt and delay bounds, 15000 ms provider timeouts, 179000/120000/179000 ms deadlines, TG/email one-shot limits, phone=0, and RED-first missing behavior are explicit and non-fabricated.
REQ-001..018 map through PROP-001..012 into draft CRIT-001..005 while L1, L2, and L3 remain separate and future evidence is not substituted by historical artifacts or builder claims.

Exact commands, exits, immutable baseline and final arithmetic, named evidence paths, independent per-module coverage, process/schema/trace/safe-scan/scope/history checks, atomic output behavior, and the separately authorized single controlled L3 surface form a binary reproducible contract.
